brief: The React Native architecture the call was observed on. `new` for a TurboModule resolved through `TurboModuleRegistry`, `legacy` for a module reached over the Old Architecture bridge. Only applies to React Native.

deprecation.reason: Replaced by the `react_native.*` namespace, which also covers native module calls made over the Old Architecture bridge, which are not TurboModules

changelog.description: Added turbo_module.arch and deprecated it in favor of react_native.architecture
